exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by different criteria (IADPSG, WHO-2006, CDA-2013, Tomic et al.)
cohort: The study included 2183 pregnant women who underwent a 75 g-OGTT between 24 and 28 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes were consistently more frequent in GDM groups, across all diagnostic systems, compared to non-GDM groups.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was identified as a predictor of complications such as cesarean delivery.
